title: LunaToolResponse
description: Unified canonical tool response envelope for all LUNA AI tool executions (success and failure).

tool.description: Identifier of the tool that executed (e.g. application_control, youtube, phone_call)

action.description: Specific action performed (e.g. open, close, search, play, capture)

spoken.description: Optional conversational feedback string for voice response

execution_time_ms.description: Measured duration of tool execution in milliseconds

verified.description: True only if post-execution state was positively verified (e.g. process checked, stream active)

data.description: Structured output data returned by the tool
